filter.description: A recursive Mingdao filter. A condition requires type=condition, field and operator; value is required except for isempty and isnotempty. A group requires type=group, logic (AND or OR, case-insensitive) and nested children. Operators and values depend on worksheet field types.

field.description: The field ID.

includeSummary.description: Whether to include summary values over all rows.

meta.description: The selected column, row and value definitions.

items.description: A pivot row with dynamic columns, rows and values.

summary.description: The summary values keyed by field ID.

actions.name: remove_role_members
actions.description: Remove users, departments, department trees, jobs or organization roles from an application role.

departmentTreeIds.description: The department tree IDs, including their child departments.

orgRoleIds.description: The organization role IDs to remove.

data.description: The upstream operation result, including any partial-success details.

actions.name: remove_user_from_all_roles
actions.description: Remove a user from every role in the connected application.

userId.description: The user ID to remove from all application roles.

data.description: The upstream operation result, including any partial-success details.

actions.name: search_knowledge
actions.description: Search Mingdao knowledge content using vector, keyword or hybrid retrieval. Knowledge bases with different embedding models must be searched in separate calls.

knowledgeIds.description: The knowledge base IDs; an empty array selects all knowledge bases.

searchMode.description: The retrieval mode: vector for semantic search, keyword for full-text search, or hybrid for both.

topK.description: The maximum number of matches, at least 1; defaults to 10.

minRelevance.description: The minimum vector-search relevance score from 0 to 1; applies only to vector mode.

rrfK.description: The reciprocal rank fusion k parameter; applies only to hybrid mode and defaults to 60.

worksheetIds.description: Restrict the search to these worksheet IDs.

types.description: The content types to search; omitting this field searches all types.

type.description: The content type: record, record_attachment, discussion_attachment or discussion.

field.description: The field ID for an attachment match.

fieldName.description: The field name for an attachment match.

attachmentId.description: The attachment ID, when the match is from an attachment.

attachmentName.description: The attachment name, when the match is from an attachment.

match.description: The match type: raw for an original chunk, enhanced for an enhanced chunk.

items.description: A matching chunk with its source and attachment metadata.

actions.name: trigger_workflow
actions.description: Trigger an existing Mingdao workflow with its defined parameters. Its configured steps may update or delete business data; the returned result does not imply that all downstream work has completed.

processId.description: The existing Mingdao workflow process ID.

parameters.description: The dynamic input values keyed by the workflow parameter aliases returned by get_workflow. Use an empty object when no parameters are required.

data.description: The dynamic output values defined by this workflow.

actions.name: update_custom_page
actions.description: Replace the complete custom-page component layout, including inline charts, views, tabs, containers and filter groups.

componentType.description: The page component type. Charts are created inline; existing chart IDs cannot be mounted.

name.description: Required title for section and chart components only; other component types use config fields.

componentId.description: A unique caller-generated UUID for tab or container only; omit for every other component type, including chart.

parentSectionId.description: The parent container componentId for container children only; mutually exclusive with parentTabId.

parentTabId.description: The target config.tabs[].tabId for tab children only; mutually exclusive with parentSectionId.

x.description: The zero-based starting column; x+w must not exceed 48.

w.description: The width in columns; full width is 48.

h.description: The height in rows; components at the same y must have the same height.

position.description: The component position and dimensions on the 48-column grid.

title.description: The component title, or the carousel title field ID.

content.description: Required rich-text HTML for text components.

url.description: The HTTP(S) iframe URL for html components, or the link field ID for carousel action=2.

objectId.description: A unique caller-generated UUID for chart/view components, matching filtersGroup objectControls references; do not use a chart ID or view ID.

chartType.description: The chart type: columnChart, barChart, lineChart, pieChart, radarChart, funnelChart, dualAxisChart, pivotTable, regionMap, numberChart, symmetricBarChart, scatterChart, wordCloud, gaugeChart, progressChart, rankingChart or worldMap. Trends use time dimensions; maps require geographic fields. Dual/symmetric charts need one values and one rightValues metric; pivotTable needs rows, columns and values; progressChart needs matching targetValues; gaugeChart needs gaugeMin/gaugeMax.

dataScope.description: The data permission scope: permission for visible data or all for all data.

timeFieldId.description: The time filter field ID; inline page charts default to ctime.

timeRange.description: The time range: all, today, yesterday, tomorrow, currentWeek, lastWeek, nextWeek, currentMonth, lastMonth, nextMonth, currentQuarter, lastQuarter, nextQuarter, currentYear, lastYear, nextYear, firstHalfYear, secondHalfYear, last7Days, last30Days, last365Days, next7Days, next30Days, next365Days, customDynamicRange or customRange. Inline page charts default to currentMonth.

customDynamicRange.description: The dynamic date range for timeRange=customDynamicRange. from/to use type today, currentMonth, currentYear, past or future; past/future require value and unit day/week/month/year.

customRange.description: The explicit date range for timeRange=customRange.

dimension.description: Non-pivot dimensions: category/time/geographic fields, first for X-axis and second for series. Maps require genuine geographic fields.

values.description: The numeric or rowid metrics to aggregate; rowid represents record count.

rightValues.description: The secondary metrics; dualAxisChart and symmetricBarChart require exactly one secondary and one primary metric.

targetValues.description: The target metrics for progressChart, matching values in count and order.

gaugeMin.description: The gaugeChart minimum as a string; required for gauges.

gaugeMax.description: The gaugeChart maximum as a string; required for gauges.

mapScope.description: The regionMap scope: country, province or city.

mapRegionCode.description: The 6-digit region code for regionMap. Province codes end in 0000; city codes end in 00. Omit for country; municipalities and special administrative regions use city-level scope even under province.

filtersGroupId.description: The filter-group ID; use an empty string for a new group.

name.description: Required title for section and chart components only; other component types use config fields.

enableBtn.description: Whether to enable the filter button.

filters.description: The filter-group definitions, including objectControls mappings to chart/view objectId values.

filter.description: The recursive filter whose root must be a group with logic AND/OR. At most group->group->condition nesting; siblings must all be groups or all conditions. Use option keys and related/member/department/role IDs, not names. isempty/isnotempty omit value.

limit.description: The maximum result count; recommended for ranking and word-cloud charts.

image.description: The attachment field ID used for carousel images.

count.description: Required for carousel (record count, default 5) and button (desktop buttons per row, default 6).

action.description: The configured action code: carousel 1 opens record, 2 opens link, 3 previews image; button entries support simple navigation 1 through 4 only.

openMode.description: Carousel link opening: 1 current page, 2 new page, 3 dialog.

explain.description: The explanation above a button group.

style.description: Button style: 1 filled rectangle, 2 rounded rectangle, 3 dashed.

width.description: Button width: 1 fit text, 2 split the row evenly.

mobileCount.description: Required mobile buttons per row for button components; default 2.

buttons.description: The button definitions; at least one, supporting action codes 1 through 4 only.

tabs.description: The tab definitions; at least one, each with a globally unique caller-generated tabId UUID.

showName.description: Whether to display the tab or container title.

showBorder.description: Whether to display the component border.

config.description: Type-specific component configuration: chart creates inline charts; text requires content; html url; view worksheetId/viewId/objectId; carousel worksheetId/viewId/image/count; button count/mobileCount/buttons; tab tabs and a top-level componentId; container top-level componentId; filtersGroup filters and objectControls mappings.

components.description: The complete replacement component list on a 48-column grid. Components sharing y must have the same height; x+w cannot exceed 48. Attachment and iframe content use accessible URLs, not local files or base64.

actions.name: update_optionset
actions.description: Update an option set's name, keyed options, order, colors and scores.

value.description: The option value; values must not be duplicated.

index.description: The integer sort order; smaller values come first.

color.description: The option color, effective when enableColor is true.

score.description: The option score, effective when enableScore is true; decimals and negative values are supported.

data.description: The upstream operation result, including any partial-success details.

actions.name: update_record
actions.description: Update a Mingdao worksheet record, replacing, adding or removing supported field values.

value.description: The value in the worksheet field format. Attachment values use accessible URLs, for example [{"name":"report.pdf","url":"https://example.com/report.pdf"}]; do not pass local files or inline base64. Attachment removal uses file IDs.

updateType.description: For updates to attachments, multiple selections, collaborators, departments, relations, subtables or organization roles: 0 replaces, 1 adds, 2 removes. Defaults to 0; omit for creation.

allowNewOptions.description: Whether single-select or multiple-select values may create missing options.

triggerWorkflow.description: Whether this record mutation triggers configured workflows.

id.description: The created or updated record ID.

actions.name: update_worksheet
actions.description: Update worksheet metadata and add, edit or delete fields.

sectionId.description: The navigation section ID; omitted application items use the first available section.

type.description: The field type: creation uses a string (named type such as Text/Relation or documented numeric string codes such as 2/6/11); worksheet updates use integer codes.

isTitle.description: Whether this field is the record title.

isHiddenOnCreate.description: Whether to hide the field when creating a record.

isUnique.description: Whether the field value must be unique.

precision.description: The decimal precision for Number fields, from 0 to 14.

subType.description: Field subtype: Collaborator 0 single or 1 multiple; Relation 1 single or 2 multiple; Time 1 hours/minutes or 6 hours/minutes/seconds; Date/DateTime 5 year, 4 month, 3 day, 2 hour, 1 minute, 6 second precision.

options.description: Selection options for SingleSelect or MultipleSelect fields.

showFields.description: The related worksheet fields to display.

relation.description: Relation settings; showFields selects displayed fields and bidirectional enables two-way links.

max.description: The maximum rating from 0 to 10 for Rating fields.

dataSource.description: The already-created related worksheet ID for Relation fields.

sourceField.description: An existing one-way relation field ID in dataSource to link bidirectionally; omit when creating a new relation.

addFields.description: The fields to add; type is an integer code for updates.

id.description: The upstream item ID or field alias.

type.description: The field type: creation uses a string (named type such as Text/Relation or documented numeric string codes such as 2/6/11); worksheet updates use integer codes.

isTitle.description: Whether this field is the record title.

isHiddenOnCreate.description: Whether to hide the field when creating a record.

isUnique.description: Whether the field value must be unique.

precision.description: The decimal precision for Number fields, from 0 to 14.

subType.description: Field subtype: Collaborator 0 single or 1 multiple; Relation 1 single or 2 multiple; Time 1 hours/minutes or 6 hours/minutes/seconds; Date/DateTime 5 year, 4 month, 3 day, 2 hour, 1 minute, 6 second precision.

options.description: Selection options for SingleSelect or MultipleSelect fields.

showFields.description: The related worksheet fields to display.

relation.description: Relation settings; showFields selects displayed fields and bidirectional enables two-way links.

max.description: The maximum rating from 0 to 10 for Rating fields.

dataSource.description: The already-created related worksheet ID for Relation fields.

sourceField.description: An existing one-way relation field ID in dataSource to link bidirectionally; omit when creating a new relation.

editFields.description: The fields to edit, identified by required id; all other field properties are optional.
